title: Banshee's Cry
description:
Deal 33 damage to ALL enemies.
Costs 2 Energy less for each [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card played this combat.
notes: When this card enters combat, its cost is reduced by 2 for each Ethereal card already played this combat. Additionally, whenever another Ethereal card is played, this card's cost is reduced by 2 for the remainder of combat.
